display.purpose: Page headings; compact discovery and dedicated event headings use the documented smaller overrides.

title.purpose: Supporting h3 headings, including the empty preview.

event-title.purpose: Result titles with open leading for long provider names.

body.purpose: Base reading text; inputs retain this size with weight 500.

body-small.purpose: Descriptions and practical event-section copy, limited to 70ch.

label.purpose: Visible form labels and utility text links.

navigation.purpose: Labeled sidebar links; the current destination uses weight 800.

small-label.purpose: Event dates, quiet controls, availability labels, and section links; date lines use tabular numerals.

metadata.purpose: Supporting event facts, freshness, source notes, and availability explanations.

date-number.purpose: The stacked date marker's day; horizontal row indexes use .9375rem instead.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for action fill, disclosure-chevron rotation, and selected-result fill.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Action background-color and filter-chevron transform transitions.

motion.name: library-button-state
motion.purpose: The library's default button timing for navigation and other buttons without an app-specific duration; the theme limits transitions to background-color and color.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes transition/animation durations and forces scroll-behavior: auto, all with !important.

narrative.overview:
Local frequency makes event discovery feel personally assembled: the presence of a record shop, the intimacy of a mixtape, and the clarity of an everyday planning tool. Cobalt navigation frames cool light reading surfaces; apricot selection and compact date indexes give the collection a warm, human rhythm.

Bold, readable Manrope and real provider photography carry the personality. Familiar labeled controls keep this an Operate-mode product: useful dates, venues, prices, and clear availability matter more than promotional decoration. Density changes with the available space while the event identity stays recognizable.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt navigation and actions against cool paper and white surfaces.
Apricot selection, date indexing, and honest availability labels.
One expressive, readable Manrope family with substantial heading weights.
Record-sleeve provider imagery and compact, aligned event facts.
Border-only depth, restrained state transitions, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Cobalt and Apricot Rule
rules.body: Cobalt carries navigation and actions; apricot marks desktop selection, date indexes, and availability, while compact bottom navigation uses soft blue for its current destination.

rules.name: The One Family, Clear Roles Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope's size, weight, leading, and spacing to distinguish headings, facts, and controls; keep dates tabular and long event names able to wrap.

rules.name: The Border-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with tone, spacing, and borders; selection changes the fill without lifting the component or adding a cast shadow.

dos: Do use cobalt for navigation and actions, cool light surfaces for reading, and apricot for the shipped selection and indexing roles.
Do keep real provider imagery, full readable dates, venue, price availability, and sale status connected to the event title.
Do preserve the 62rem context/rail threshold and 72rem full-sidebar threshold when extending the shared shell.
Do keep visible focus, wrapping titles, labeled controls, reduced motion, and ordinary link/form behavior.
Do explain unavailable participation, unknown event facts, and stale provider data in text.
donts: Don't add cast shadows, glass effects, or raised hover cards to this flat, border-defined system.
Don't force provider photographs into monochrome or substitute decorative stock imagery for event identity.
Don't style planned accounts, saves, interest, recommendations, or discussions as completed actions or fabricate participation counts.
Don't use promotional clutter or manufactured urgency to compete with practical event information.
Don't promote route-specific composition or synthesized sidecar tonal ramps into new global design tokens.
